title: Continue ooRexx Speech work
procedure: Check the Rasen Falcon oorexx-speech lane and Library/Git before coding.
Keep Speech ownership separate from SIP/RTP, HTTPS/LDAP, Storage/Layered Audio and local device ownership.
Run the strict ooRexx standards gate on every new Rexx source delta.
Use independent r13196 qualification for cross-package runtime claims; do not promote static inspection into runtime PASS.
For remote publication, use explicit RPC Core registration and the platform HTTPS/LDAP authority. Do not expose local temp paths or PCM streaming over unary JSON-RPC.
